100 hiram sq|08901.summary: The Brunswick residents praise the exceptional staff, particularly management and maintenance teams who respond quickly and professionally. Many highlight the modern, updated apartments with new washer-dryer units and prime location near downtown. The pet-friendly community has improved significantly under current management. However, some note the lack of outdoor spaces like patios or rooftop areas.

reviews.name: Jose Russa
reviews.body: Moved in this October and it's been a great experience. The sales office personnel have been great. Incredibly accommodating and responsive. The maintenance team is also very friendly. They have an online service request and package arrival notification system which is great! Very happy with my choice to move into Riverwatch.

reviews.name: Matt Goetz
reviews.body: I moved in back in 2020 when this wasn't owned by the same Management company, now Aion.  Since they took over, the office staff, maintenance, and the public/common areas have all dramatically improved.  The office and maintenance get back with you the same day and are all extremely friendly and helpful.  With a great staff that take care of the property and an ideal location, I would highly recommend living here.

response.body: Hi Matt, Thank you so much for taking the time to leave this kind review! Feedback like this truly makes our day and we are so delighted that you are happy with the community and are enjoying your time here. Thank you for choosing to make The Brunswick your home and if there is anything we can do for you going forward, please be sure to let us know! Thank you kindly - The team at The Brunswick

reviews.name: Rima Ray
reviews.body: Absolutely love living here! Shaniece is one of the kindest, most efficient apartment managers I have ever had. The maintenance staff are all very friendly & fast as well! Truly an amazing, pet friendly, and beautiful community to live in. Would 10/10 recommend

reviews.name: Othman Mustafa
reviews.body: Lived here for 2 years.  Incredible staff, very attentive to my needs.  Incredible location to Downtown New Brunswick.  Reserved Parking is also a plus.  They just put in washer and dryer into every apartment.  Modern and up to date.  I would of stayed here if i wasn't moving to texas.  I highly recommend this place

reviews.name: Thea Thea
reviews.body: These are beautiful apartments. Maintenance and management helps immediately with any problem. I'm very satisfied.

response.body: Thanks, Thea! We're thrilled you find our apartments beautiful and appreciate our prompt maintenance and management team. We're committed to maintaining this high standard. Looking forward to exceeding your expectations in the future!

reviews.name: Richard Trabucco
reviews.body:
My washer-dryer combination unit had run it's useful life. I put in  maintenance request for a new washer-dryer. Three days later, maintenence crews installed a new washer-dryer unit. It works very well. I'm very pleased with the quick response from the maintenance crew and mgmt.
Thank You

response.body: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience with us! We truly appreciate your kind words and are so happy to hear that you had a great experience. If there is anything we can do for you going forward, please be sure to let us know. Thanks again! - The team at The Brunswick

reviews.name: Brent Shipe
reviews.body: My apartment looked brand new the day I moved in. It is up to date and has a more modern design than some of my past apartments. The location is great, within waking distance of great beer bats that aren't riddled with college students. The best part however is the management staff. Everyone on staff is helpful and outgoing. I've not only met, but had meaningful conversions with both the office personnel and the maintenance staff, I couldn't be happier with them!

reviews.name: Timothy Bracaglia
reviews.body:
Great apartments, good pricing (at least compared with other luxury apartments in the area) and great staff.  The leasing agents are all super kind and helpful and the maintenance team couldn't be kinder or quicker to respond.

My only complaint: there is absolutely no outdoor space to speak of. No patio, no deck, no park, no rooftop garden, no nothing. Add an outdoor space and this would be the best deal in town.

Either way, I'll keep renewing my lease for now.
